$comment: Prompts for tools/generate-sfx.mjs (ElevenLabs Sound Effects). Each kind has a length in seconds (20 credits a second) and may set how closely the sound follows the prompt (influence, 0–1, 0.5 when left out); an approved draft goes to src/client/audio/sfx/<id>.mp3 and into data/sounds.json. A kind with tts is speech (ElevenLabs text to speech): each prompt names a voice and a text or a card of data/tutorial.json; it costs creditsPerCharacter for each character, and an approved recording goes to src/client/audio/narration/<card>.mp3 and into data/tutorial.json (voice).
